0022600216.text: The Trail Blazers (6-3, 1-2 at home, 5-1 on the road) host the Thunder (8-2, 5-0 at home, winners of four straight) as Portland looks to snap a two-game losing streak, sitting 3rd in the Northwest and 8th in the West while Oklahoma City is 1st in the Northwest and 2nd in the West. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Trail Blazers lost 1-3 to the Thunder, including a 124-95 loss in Oklahoma City on December 31, 2025. Portland will be without Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle), with Robert Williams III listed as day-to-day with a rest-related game-time decision, while Oklahoma City is missing Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Jaylin Williams, and Thomas Sorber.
